eligibility_conditions_and_restrictions: Mandatory stratification key; 6 distinct PI categories
physical_interpretation_and_audit_notes: Identifies the NASA Principal Investigator responsible for the test protocol and fuel category (Bhattacharjee=thin PMMA; Miller=thick PMMA slabs; Olson=clear rods/stagnation; Fernandez-Pello=black rods/opposed; T'ien=SIBAL fabric; Ferkul=Nomex/candle).

eligibility_conditions_and_restrictions: Mandatory primary natural key; exactly 129 unique flight test IDs
physical_interpretation_and_audit_notes: Unique NASA flight run code (e.g. B1 to B22; M1 to M20; O1 to O27; P1 to P27; T1 to T29; F1 to F4). Fully reconciled 129/129 against BASS-II Test Matrix XLSX.

eligibility_conditions_and_restrictions: Preserve raw string verbatim without timezone shifting
physical_interpretation_and_audit_notes: Actual calendar date on ISS. README notes onboard video display date was shifted by +1 day due to leap year bug.

eligibility_conditions_and_restrictions: Integer range 45 to 216; chronological run sequencing
physical_interpretation_and_audit_notes: Greenwich Mean Time Julian day of year for the ISS run. Essential covariate to track sequential background chamber gas accumulation during daily runs.

eligibility_conditions_and_restrictions: Clustering key for repeated runs; 107 distinct specimen IDs
physical_interpretation_and_audit_notes: Hardware fuel specimen index. At least 20 specimens were burned multiple times (e.g. 144m; 220m). Must be used as a cluster group to avoid pseudoreplication.

eligibility_conditions_and_restrictions: Categorical mapping to 6 PI fuel classes; 51 raw descriptions
physical_interpretation_and_audit_notes: Specimen geometry and material description. Categorized strictly into PI morphology classes. Do NOT compute numerical Biot numbers using unmeasured constants.
Perforated duct baffle plate configuration: 0 = no restrictor (lowest flow resistance); 1 = intermediate; 2 = highest restriction. Alters flow cross-section and speed range.

eligibility_conditions_and_restrictions: Do not treat as scalar; 97 complex adjustment sequences
physical_interpretation_and_audit_notes: Instantaneous fan motor voltage x 10 (e.g. 122 = 12.2V; 38 = 3.8V). 13 nulls. Fan turns off at >3.8V. Static analyses must filter out multi-value sequences.

eligibility_conditions_and_restrictions: Static velocity analysis restricted to 25 single scalar entries
physical_interpretation_and_audit_notes: Hot-wire anemometer duct flow readout in cm/s. Authentic linear calibration: U = 1.0066 * Air (cm/s). 100 entries contain complex adjustment sequences or operator notes; sensor has ~1 min response lag.

eligibility_conditions_and_restrictions: Exploratory flame intensity scaling; values {10; 50; 250; 1000; transitions}
physical_interpretation_and_audit_notes: Narrow-band flame radiometer amplifier gain setting. Essential to scale relative photodiode millivolts into comparative radiation intensity.

eligibility_conditions_and_restrictions: Exploratory duration proxy only; do NOT calculate flame spread rate
physical_interpretation_and_audit_notes: Digital Nikon still camera frames acquired. Contains non-numeric tokens ('none'; 'video'). Does NOT represent steady-state flame spread duration.
Pre-ignition glovebox oxygen concentration calibrated against ISS Major Constituent Analyzer (MCA). Fully eligible for environmental statistics and paired depletion.

eligibility_conditions_and_restrictions: Quarantine 5 gross anomalies (B2; P22a; P22b; T28a; T28b); 2 'none'
physical_interpretation_and_audit_notes: Post-burn glovebox oxygen concentration. Exactly 122 valid paired records after excluding 5 recording swaps and 2 'none'. 5 negative drift runs retained but flagged.

eligibility_conditions_and_restrictions: Range 0.0% to 1.9% (0.000 to 0.019 mol/mol); 2 'none' mapped to NULL
physical_interpretation_and_audit_notes: Pre-ignition carbon dioxide concentration measured via non-dispersive infrared (NDIR) sensor. Reflects background combustion byproduct accumulation in MSG.
Post-burn carbon dioxide concentration. Combined with initial CO2 to evaluate stoichiometric carbon conversion and apparent respiratory quotient (RQ).

eligibility_conditions_and_restrictions: Range -3 to 950 ppm; 13 negative drift values preserved; 2 'none'; 1 'OR'
physical_interpretation_and_audit_notes: Pre-ignition carbon monoxide trace concentration via CSA-CP sensor. Negative values (-1; -2; -3 ppm) represent uncalibrated zero drift; must be preserved signed.

eligibility_conditions_and_restrictions: Range 0.3 to 950 ppm; preserve saturation tokens ('>500'; 'over'; 'OR')
physical_interpretation_and_audit_notes: Post-burn carbon monoxide concentration. Exactly 0 negative values. High concentrations (>100 ppm on 58 runs) and sensor saturation indicate incomplete combustion.
